title: Decode Early, Verify Late: Streaming Offline Speech Recognizers Without Accuracy Loss
abstract: arXiv:2611.20064v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Voice agents need accurate transcripts soon after a user stops speaking. We propose Decode Early, Verify Late (DEVL), a training-free framework for streaming inference with offline ASR models. The server keeps partial transcripts as drafts and verifies the latest against the complete audio in one forward pass at turn end. Under stated input and decoding conditions, the final equals the model's greedy offline output in exact arithmetic. We adapt DEVL to four model families. In our five-recognizer comparison, 95-100% of final transcripts are byte-identical to the offline transcripts, WER stays within 0.13 points of offline, and single-stream time to final falls 1.5-7.3x. Serving Qwen3-ASR-1.7B on one A100, DEVL returns finals a median 22-26 ms after turn end at up to 64 streams, 2.7-3.9x sooner than the official streaming mode. It is the only system we tested that meets a 100 ms p99 target, up to 80 streams on Pipecat-STT and 64 on WildASR

translated_title: 早解码，晚验证：无精度损失的离线语音识别器流式化方法
translated_abstract: 语音智能体需要在用户停止说话后尽快获得准确的转录文本。我们提出了"早解码，晚验证"（DEVL），这是一个无需训练的框架，可实现离线ASR模型的流式推理。服务器将部分转录文本保存为草稿，并在轮次结束时通过一次前向传播将最新草稿与完整音频进行验证。在给定的输入和解码条件下，最终结果在精确算术意义上等于模型的贪心离线输出。我们将DEVL适配到四个模型家族。在五个识别器的对比实验中，95-100%的最终转录文本与离线转录文本字节完全一致，词错误率（WER）与离线结果的差距保持在0.13个百分点以内，单流的最终结果生成时间降低了1.5-7.3倍。在一块A100上部署Qwen3-ASR-1.7B时，DEVL在多达64路并发流的情况下，中位数在轮次结束后22-26毫秒内返回最终结果，比官方流式模式快2.7-3.9倍。它是我们测试中唯一满足100毫秒p99延迟目标的系统，在Pipecat-STT上支持多达80路并发流，在WildASR上支持64路并发流。
tldr: 提出了无需训练的DEVL框架，通过提前解码草稿转录、在轮次结束时用一次前向传播对完整音频进行验证的方式，让离线ASR模型实现流式推理且几乎零精度损失，最终结果延迟降低1.5-7.3倍。
en_tdlr: DEVL is a training-free framework that enables offline ASR models to stream by decoding draft transcripts early and verifying the latest draft against the complete audio in one forward pass at turn end, achieving near-lossless accuracy with 1.5-7.3x faster time-to-final.
